## Hypothesis

Extending the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE signal to 3DTE will capture additional edge by reducing theta decay on entry, similar to the observed monotonic improvement from 0DTE to 1DTE to 2DTE. The edge is expected to persist or improve at 3DTE due to lower time premium erosion, allowing the signal's directional edge to manifest more fully.

## Mechanism

Same as WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE: take the same directional signal (e.g., vwap_continuation) but instead of 0DTE, use options with exactly 3 days to expiration. Strike remains ITM-2, exit rules remain -8% stop / +30% target. Entry and exit logic unchanged; only DTE variable is adjusted to 3.
